pr_title: roachtest: increase passing criteria for elasticWorkload test
pr_body:
Change the passing criteria for the perturbation/*/elasticWorkload tests from 5.0 to 20.0. We have seen a number of failures where the value is in the 6-12 range and by increasing this we will prevent many of the flakes. Ideally we will drop this number in the future.

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/133557
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/134104

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/134203)

review_comments: What about other tests, e.g. `addNode` / `decommission`? Are they less susceptible to this flakiness?

Those tests are much more reliable at 5.0 (see https://roachperf.crdb.dev/?filter=perturbation&view=perturbation&tab=gce for some examples). Decommission is slightly above addNode, but they are both typically well below the 5.0 increase. The elastic workload is typically 3-4x above and often can get above 5x.
